I have farmed this small 0.16-hectare plot for many years, and I know that buying even one bag of fertilizer is too much money for such a small piece of land, especially when I also have other plots to think about. I will carry manure from my home and put it on this field because I own it and manure does not cost me cash, but I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer or improved seed this season — I will use the seed I kept from last year and my own family's labor. My children and I will work this plot together, and I expect we will spend about 25 days on it from planting to harvest; I will not hire anyone because I do not have extra money for wages.
